mapper.sql: id, name, scope, group_id, status, feature, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM knowledge_base ORDER BY update_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_base (name, scope, group_id, status, feature, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{name}, #{scope}, #{groupId}, #{status}, #{feature, typeHandler=com.dingring.infrastructure.persistence.typehandler.JsonMapTypeHandler}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_base SET name = #{name}, scope = #{scope}, group_id = #{groupId}, status = #{status}, feature = #{feature, typeHandler=com.dingring.infrastructure.persistence.typehandler.JsonMapTypeHandler}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}
